impact: A big AI investor posting losses keeps pressure on AI-funding sentiment around MSFT, NBIS and the chip complex, though the OpenAI stake itself was not marked down.
summary: SoftBank Group reported a fiscal Q2 net loss of 1.12T yen (about $7.1B), its first in almost two years, vs a 2.5T yen profit a year ago and a 129B yen profit expected per Bloomberg. Falling Arm, Intel and Coupang shares and higher financing costs drove it; reports say no OpenAI gain or loss was booked.
title: SoftBank swings to $7.1B Q2 net loss as Arm, Intel, Coupang slide
